name: Elune's Tear
summary: In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon seeks a cure for his ailing daughter, Relara. The brew made from Bathran's hair slowed her sickness, but did not cleanse it. He asks you to bring Elune's Tear from Iris Lake, hoping its sacred power can drive the corruption from her.

sections.title: A Father's Growing Panic
sections.body: Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter, Relara, lies gravely ill in Astranaar. He hoped a draught made from Bathran's hair would heal her, but though Orendil Broadleaf's brew slowed the sickness, it did not clear it from her body. Ordinary remedies have not been enough. Pelturas now turns to the old traditions of his people and seeks a cure touched by divine cleansing light.

sections.title: The Stone of Iris Lake
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf named a stronger remedy in case the herbal brew failed: Elune's Tear, a sacred stone found on an island in Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Night elves believe the stone bears the Moon Goddess's blessing and can purge corruption from the living. Troubled water elementals patrol the lake's shallows and banks, guarding its waters.

sections.title: A Measure of Hope
sections.body: When you bring the stone to Astranaar, Pelturas plans to steep it in a medicinal broth for Relara. He gives thanks, but the corruption still lingers, and her life remains in danger.

faq.answer: Elune's Tear is a sacred stone found on the central isle of Iris Lake in Ashenvale. Night elven lore says it can cleanse severe poisons and lingering corruption.

faq.q: Why did Orendil's previous cure fail?
faq.answer: Orendil Broadleaf's brew, made from Bathran's hair, slowed Relara's illness but could not overcome it. Pelturas turned to sacred remedies when herbs proved insufficient.
Iris Lake lies east of Astranaar in Ashenvale. Follow the main road east out of town, then take the dirt path north beside a stream that feeds the lake.

faq.q: What dangers lurk around Iris Lake?
faq.answer: Territorial water elementals inhabit Iris Lake and its central isle. Anyone approaching the isle to claim the Tear must pass these hostile nature spirits.

faq.q: How does Pelturas plan to use the stone?
faq.answer: Pelturas plans to steep Elune's Tear in a medicinal stew for his daughter Relara, hoping its cleansing power will drive out her affliction.
Relara Whitemoon is the young night elf daughter of Pelturas Whitemoon, and she lives in Astranaar. An unnatural corruption has left her gravely ill and threatens her life.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the faith placed in sacred stones named for the Moon Goddess, and in Elune's grace to cleanse wounds ordinary remedies cannot reach.
As a priest devoted to Elune, you know the faith placed in holy relics to fight dark, unnatural plagues when prayer calls for a physical aid.
As a druid, you know the waters of Ashenvale and the erratic elementals that guard the quiet heart of Iris Lake.
As an Alliance member, you help Astranaar's defenders through a personal crisis as danger grows across Ashenvale.
